answer: A newcomer locks a 160 POA bond for 70 days and starts on a probation island, its first three jobs paid into escrow, so one fake identity costs 160 POA plus 70 days of locked work. Each job ends with a cipher receipt signed by the paying client, and buyers check the public chain of receipts before hiring. Five auditors drawn by lot replay one receipt each month. A forged receipt costs the whole bond plus the escrowed pay, and the key goes on the public canyon list for a year.
